L190: # Tacto Negotiation Arena - starter kit
L191: 
L192: A Python client for the arena API, two example buyer agents that negotiate by e-mail, helpers that read the suppliers' documents and price a term sheet, a runner that plays many cases in parallel, `arena-sim` - a local simulator of the arena's API - and a read-only MCP server over the data package. Read the brief first (`../brief/brief.md`); the full API is in `../brief/api.md`. Code: MIT.
L193: ## Quickstart - first agent on the board in 15 minutes
L194: 
L195: You need Python 3.12 and cite71†uv†docs.astral.sh .
L196: 1. Get your team's key (one per team): open `https://arena.tacto.ai/apply`, enter your team name and a contact e-mail, and show the match code it displays at the Tacto desk. Once an organiser approves, the key appears once on that page - copy it and press "Got the key". Only that page (or its link) shows it; lost it → ask the organisers to reset it. Keep it out of git.
L197: 
L198:     cd starter-kit
L199:     uv sync --all-extras            # 2. install
L200:     cp .env.example .env            # 3. put ARENA_URL and your key (ARENA_API_KEY) into .env
L201:     uv run arena me                 # 4. your team and its practice quota
L202:     uv run arena cases              # 5. the practice cases (the 10 hosted ones are playable)
L203:     uv run arena play case:P01 -v   # 6. the naive agent negotiates one case
L204:     uv run arena board              # 7. you are on the practice leaderboard
L205: Is the arena up? `curl $ARENA_URL/health`.
L206: Step 6 prints the deal, your total cost `c_deal` against `c_open` and `c_best`, the case score, and a replay link: every e-mail and the supplier's reasons for each move, in words. That is the learning loop - play a practice case, read the replay, improve your agent, play again. In practice your best score per case counts, so play a case again whenever your agent improves. Quota: 200 practice sessions per team per rolling 24 hours.
L207: `arena play` and `arena run` print how many are left; `arena run` plays only the hosted practice cases and stops starting new ones once the quota is used up (a `429` there does not go away by retrying). Plan your runs.
L208: Now the LLM agent. Download the data (`ARENA_DATA=data/package` in `.env`), choose a model in `.env` (your own key), then:

L211:     uv run arena play case:P01 --agent llm -v
L212:     uv run arena run --set practice --agent llm --parallel 8   # every hosted practice case, 8 at a time
L213:     uv run arena play case:D02 -v                              # the sandbox: 3 demo suppliers, no board
L214: Sunday 08:00: run `arena data` again - it adds `data/release-sunday` (new news, letters, a memo). `DataPackage` merges its facts and documents automatically; hidden cases may cite them.

L217: 
L218:     # terminal 1: the simulator (--data is optional: leave it out until you have run `arena data`)
L219:     uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package
L220:     # terminal 2: a simulator key, then the naive agent plays case:S01
L221:     ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 uv run arena register "Hello World" sim                  # prints an api_key
L222:     ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 ARENA_API_KEY=<the api_key> uv run arena play case:S01 -v
L223: It prints the deal, `c_deal` against `c_open` and `c_best`, the score and a replay link - open it in your browser: the result on top, then every e-mail of the negotiation.
L224: ## Try it by hand (Postman, curl)
L225: Feel the API before you put a model in front of it. On the real arena (practice and sandbox) the 60-second rule applies: three late replies in a row end the thread - too fast for typing. By hand, use the simulator first, without the clock:
L226: 
L227:     uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package           # data/package from `arena data`; --data is optional
L228:     ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 uv run arena register "Team Name" sim   # prints a simulator api_key
L229:     export SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8000 KEY=<the api_key>
L230: Every call sends `X-API-Key: <key>`; every `POST` also `Content-Type: application/json` and a fresh `X-Move-Id` (any unique string - the same id again returns the same answer). In Postman: those headers, the body as raw JSON.
L231: 
L232:     # 1. the cases: case:S01 has one supplier, sup:70270, and the negotiable fields unit_price, payment_days
L233:     curl -s "$SIM/v1/cases?set=practice" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
L234:     # 2. open a session: the reply carries session_id (sim1 on a fresh simulator) and each supplier's quote e-mail
L235:     curl -s -X POST "$SIM/v1/sessions" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
L236:       -H "X-Move-Id: open-1" -d '{"case_id": "case:S01"}'
L237: 
L238:     # 3. the supplier's opening e-mail: its term sheet (offer:70270-0) and the quote PDF to fetch
L239:     curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
L240:     # 4. your e-mail with an offer: the reply is the supplier's answer (status, term_sheets, claim_results)
L241:     curl -s -X POST "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270/messages" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" \
L242:       -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Move-Id: msg-1" \
L243:       -d '{"message": {"subject": "Adapter piece HI", "body": "Thank you for your quote. We offer 15.50 EUR at 60 days.",
L244:            "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 15.5, "payment_days": 60}}]}}'
L245:     # 5. read the reply in the thread, and the session state
L246:     curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
L247:     curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
L248: To close, send `{"message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": "offer:70270-1"}}}` (the term sheet you take) or `{"message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}` to the same `messages` path; the answer carries the result and score. The quote PDF: `GET $SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/attachments/att:70270-0-quote`. The same calls work on the arena (`https://arena.tacto.ai`, your team's key, a practice case) - with the clock running.
L249: ## The Live Final: waves, in parallel, within the cap
L250: 
L251: The final comes in 5 themed waves. A wave holds several hidden cases that appear when the host starts it; play them all in parallel (up to 10 open sessions per key). Each wave has a hard cap - 8 minutes (the host may extend one) - and what is still open then ends without a deal. Start the runner before the first wave and leave it running:
L252: 
L253:     uv run arena run --set final --agent llm --parallel 10
L254: It polls `GET /v1/cases?set=final`, plays every case of a new wave at once (one agent per case), closes each case 90 seconds before its wave's cap (read from the wave's `seconds_left`, so an extension counts) - earlier if a round in that case took longer (`play.closing_move`: the cheapest standing term sheet that keeps the must-haves and beats your alternative, else walk away) and stops after the fifth wave has closed. If it crashes, start it again: it picks up the sessions it had started.

"""Faithful single-part P10 recorded case loading; synthetic clocks, no remote authority."""

import hashlib

from .offline import OfflineRecordedInputs


def term_binding(field, value):
    if field in {"unit_price", "tooling_eur", "chargeback_eur_per_complaint"}:
        value = str(value)
    return dict(field=field, value=value)


def case_contract(raw, basis):
    if (
        raw["case_id"] != "case:P10"
        or len(raw["suppliers"]) != 1
        or len(raw["parts"]) != 1
        or raw["buyer"]["alternative"]["kind"] != "none"
    ):
        raise ValueError("loader supports one-part P10 with no executable alternative")
    b = raw["buyer"]

    def price(value):
        return {"amount": str(value), "basis": basis.model_dump(mode="json")}

    buyer = dict(
        category_goal=b["category_goal"],
        need_per_year=str(b["need_per_year"]),
        horizon_years=str(b["horizon_years"]),
        current_price=price(b["current_unit_price"]),
        fallback_price=price(b["fallback_unit_price"]),
        interest_rate=str(b["interest_rate"]),
        reference_payment_days=b["reference_payment_days"],
        need_lead_time_days=b["need_lead_time_days"],
        fallback_risk_pct=str(b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0)),
        index_risk_pct=str(b.get("index_risk_pct", 0)),
        late_cost_per_day={"amount": str(b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0))},
        cost_per_defect={"amount": str(b.get("cost_per_defect", 0))},
        sustainable_margin_pct=str(b["sustainable_margin_pct"]),
        relationship_eur_per_point={"amount": str(b["relationship_eur_per_point"])},
        freight=[dict(incoterm=k, eur_per_unit=str(v)) for k, v in b["freight_eur_per_unit"].items()],
        index_paths=[dict(series=k, delta_fraction=str(v)) for k, v in b.get("index_paths", {}).items()],
        must_haves=b["must_haves"],
        alternative=dict(kind="unavailable", reason_code="case-has-no-executable-alternative"),
    )
    # TermBinding's strict JSON decoder resolves Decimal/date/index types without repair.
    raw_contract = dict(
        case_id=raw["case_id"],
        case_type=raw["type"],
        title=raw["title"],
        supplier_ids=raw["suppliers"],
        parts=[dict(part_id=raw["parts"][0], price_basis=basis.model_dump(mode="json"))],
        negotiable_fields=raw["negotiable"],
        fixed_terms=[term_binding(k, v) for k, v in sorted(raw["fixed_terms"].items())],
        options=[
            dict(field=k, values=v, allow_verified_standard=False) for k, v in sorted(raw["term_options"].items())
        ],
        buyer=buyer,
        round_limit=raw["round_limit"],
        case_facts=[],
        refs=raw.get("refs", []),
        contract_hash="0" * 64,
    )
    contract = m.CaseContract.model_validate_json(json.dumps(raw_contract))
    return contract.model_copy(update={"contract_hash": case_contract_hash(contract)})

        indexes=(),

    def __init__(self, *, transport, ledger=None):
        self.transport = transport
        self.ledger = ledger

        if ledger is not None:

_CUES = {
    "request": r"(?:\b(please|request|need|want|could you|can you)\b|\b(which|what|when|who|how)\b[^?]*\?)",
    "refusal": r"\b(no|not|cannot|can't|won't|refuse|unable)\b",
    "conditional_offer": r"\b(if|unless|provided|subject to|conditional)\b",
    "constraint": r"\b(must|cannot|can't|minimum|maximum|at least|no more|require|only)\b",
    "approval_requirement": r"\b(approv|authori|manager|sign.off)",
    "stated_driver": r"\b(cost|energy|material|inflation|increase|capacity)\b",
    "ambiguity": r".+",
}
_UNKNOWN = {"approval", "discount", "conditions", "contradiction", "scope", "support", "supplier preference"}
_QUESTION_INFORMATION = "Clarify the reported uncertainty."


def ground(draft, projection):
    messages = {msg.message_id: msg for msg in projection.conversation.messages}
    observations = {o.observation_id: o for o in draft.observations}
    if len(observations) != len(draft.observations):
        raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: duplicate observation identity")

    def citation(c):
        if not isinstance(c, m.MessageSpan):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: evidence excluded from this projection")
        msg = messages.get(c.message_id)
        if (msg is None or c.session_id != msg.session_id or c.thread_id != msg.thread_id
                or c.end > len(msg.body) or msg.body[c.start:c.end] != c.quote):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: invalid message span")
        if _CONDITIONAL.search(msg.body) and (c.start != 0 or c.end != len(msg.body)):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional antecedent must be retained")
        return c.quote

    for obs in draft.observations:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in obs.citations)
        if obs.summary not in quotes or not any(re.search(_CUES[obs.kind], q, re.I) for q in quotes):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: quotation does not support bounded observation kind")
        if obs.kind != "conditional_offer" and any(_CONDITIONAL.search(q) for q in quotes):
            if obs.kind not in ("refusal", "approval_requirement", "ambiguity"):
                raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional statement mislabeled unconditional")
        if obs.package_fingerprint is not None:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: no package reference admitted in this input slice")
    for constraint in draft.reported_constraints:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in constraint.citations)
        value = str(constraint.value)
        if (not quotes or not any(re.search(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(value) + r"(?![\w.])", q) for q in quotes)
                or not any(re.search(_CUES["constraint"], q, re.I) for q in quotes)
                or any(re.search(r"\b(prefer|would like)\b", q, re.I) for q in quotes)
                or not set(constraint.condition_observation_refs) <= observations.keys()):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported explicit constraint")
        cues = {"==": r"\b(only|exactly|must be|require)\b", "!=": r"\b(not|cannot|can't)\b",
                ">=": r"\b(at least|minimum)\b", "<=": r"\b(at most|maximum|no more)\b"}
        dimensions = {"payment_days": r"\bpayment\b", "lead_time_days": r"\b(delivery|lead)\b",
                      "unit_price": r"\b(price|EUR|€)\b", "volume_per_year": r"\b(volume|units)\b",
                      "contract_months": r"\b(contract|months)\b"}
        if (constraint.dimension not in dimensions
                or not any(re.search(dimensions[constraint.dimension], q, re.I)
                           and re.search(cues[constraint.op], q, re.I) for q in quotes)):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported dimension/operator")
        conditional = any(_CONDITIONAL.search(q) for q in quotes)
        linked = [observations[r] for r in constraint.condition_observation_refs]
        if conditional and not any(o.kind == "conditional_offer" and set(o.citations) & set(constraint.citations)
                                   for o in linked):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional constraint lost its antecedent")
    for hypothesis in draft.hypotheses:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in (*hypothesis.supporting_refs, *hypothesis.contradicting_refs))
        if (not quotes or hypothesis.summary not in quotes or hypothesis.numeric_effect is not None
                or hypothesis.confidence not in ("low", "unknown")):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: uncalibrated or unsupported hypothesis")
        if hypothesis.relation == "prefers" and not any(re.search(r"\b(prefer|rather|would like)\b", q, re.I)
                                                        for q in quotes):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: preference lacks an explicit cue")
    for uncertainty in draft.uncertainties:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in uncertainty.citations)
        if (not quotes or uncertainty.summary not in quotes
                or not set(uncertainty.related_observation_refs) <= observations.keys()):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported uncertainty")
    # Internal clarification suggestions do not register outbound actions.
    for question in draft.questions:
        for c in question.citations:
            citation(c)
        if (not question.citations or question.template_id != "clarify:terms"
                or question.unknown_id not in draft.unknowns
                or question.expected_information != _QUESTION_INFORMATION):
            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: unregistered clarification suggestion")
    if not set(draft.unknowns) <= _UNKNOWN:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: unregistered question/unknown label")
    for obs in draft.observations:
        if obs.kind == "approval_requirement" and "approval" not in draft.unknowns:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: approval authority must remain unknown")
    for a in draft.reported_constraints:
        for b in draft.reported_constraints:
            if (a.constraint_id != b.constraint_id and a.dimension == b.dimension and a.op == b.op == "=="
                    and a.value != b.value and a.status == b.status == "active"
                    and not any(u.kind == "contradiction" and u.blocking for u in draft.uncertainties)):
                raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: contradictory constraints need blocking uncertainty")
    return draft

    def __init__(self, client, attempt, changed):
        super().__init__(client)
        self.attempt, self.changed = attempt, changed
        self.rounds = 0
        self.seen_threads = {}

    def open(self, case_id):
        case, threads = super().open(case_id)
        self.attempt.session_id = self.session_id
        self.changed()  # durably record identity before documents or the first decision
        self.seen_threads = threads
        observer = getattr(getattr(self, "agent", None), "observe_lab_session", None)
        if callable(observer):
            observer(self.run_id, self.session_id)
        return case, threads

    def send(self, supplier_id, message):
        self.rounds += 1
        return super().send(supplier_id, message)

    def close(self, supplier_id, message):
        self.rounds += 1
        return super().close(supplier_id, message)


def collect_session(client, attempt, arena_url, *, budget):
    """Only owned session/thread reads, after negotiation; never spectator routes."""
    if not attempt.session_id:
        return
    try:
        state = client.session(attempt.session_id)
        attempt.replay_url = replay_url(state.get("replay_url"), arena_url)
        if type(state.get("rounds")) is int:
            attempt.rounds = max(0, state["rounds"])
        threads, timeouts = {}, 0
        for supplier in list(state.get("threads", {}))[:100]:
            thread = client.thread(attempt.session_id, supplier)
            threads[supplier] = thread
            timeout_values = thread.get("timeouts", [])
            timeouts += len(timeout_values) if isinstance(timeout_values, list) else max(0, int(timeout_values or 0))
        attempt.threads = sanitize(threads, budget=budget)

def test_tracked_lab_drives_v2_multiple_rounds_and_retrieves_real_outcome(tmp_path):
    report = run_local(tmp_path)
    assert report['hosted_calls'] == report['remote_writes'] == 0
    assert len(report['runs']) == 3
    snapshots = {r.run_id: r for _, r in load_snapshots(tmp_path / 'runs')}
    for row in report['runs']:
        assert row['status'] == 'completed' and row['error'] is None
        assert row['rounds'] == row['traces_verified'] == 6
        assert row['deal'] is False and row['score'] == 0
        assert row['buyer_cost'] is None  # No agreement cost invented from validated offer costs.
        run = snapshots[row['run_id']]
        assert run.environment == 'simulator' and run.attempts[0].timeouts == 0
        paths = sorted((tmp_path / 'traces' / row['run_id']).glob('*/decision-*.json'))
        previous = None
        for round_index, path in enumerate(paths):
            trace = OfflineDecisionTrace.model_validate_json(path.read_bytes())
            trace.verify()
            assert trace.snapshot.session_id == row['session_id']
            assert trace.snapshot.run_id == row['run_id']
            assert trace.snapshot.state_version == round_index
            assert trace.assessment.parent_assessment_id == previous
            previous = trace.assessment.assessment_id
            assert trace.validation.kind == 'valid' and trace.validated_message_bytes
            assert len(trace.model_calls) == {'minimum': 0, 'direct': 1, 'grounded': 2}[row['arm']]
            assert all(c.consumer_admitted is True and c.result_kind == 'success' for c in trace.model_calls)
            assert not any(c.fallback_used for c in trace.model_calls)
            assert all(s.status == 'completed' for s in trace.stages)
            assert path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
        assert all(d['cost_delta'] == '0.0' for d in row['metrics']['decisions'])

"""Public Arena thread normalization shared by simulator and hosted contract inputs.

This reader grants no execution or closing authority. Only server-returned buyer
messages are acknowledged; proposals and locally submitted requests are excluded.
"""

import hashlib
import json

from arena_kit.cost import closing_terms
from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms

from ..core import models as m
from ..core.errors import ContractViolation
from ..core.serialization import semantic_hash
from .p10 import term_binding


def bindings(terms):
    return tuple(m.TermBinding.model_validate_json(json.dumps(term_binding(k, v)))
                 for k, v in sorted(terms.items()))


def conversation_from_arena(case, events, *, session_id, supplier_id, now, attachment_bytes):
    supplier_events = [e for e in events if e.get('from') not in {'buyer', 'arena'}]
    if not supplier_events:
        raise ContractViolation('scope_mismatch: missing supplier thread')
    thread_id = supplier_events[0]['thread_id']
    latest = supplier_events[-1]
    standing_id = (latest.get('term_sheets') or [{}])[0].get('term_sheet_id')
    messages = []
    for index, event in enumerate(events):
        speaker = event.get('from') if event.get('from') in {'buyer', 'arena'} else 'supplier'
        if speaker == 'supplier' and event['thread_id'] != thread_id:
            raise ContractViolation('scope_mismatch: mixed Arena threads')
        # Official buyer history has no server message ID. Identity derives from its
        # position and exact acknowledged payload, never from a pending proposal.
        message_id = event.get('message_id') or 'buyer:' + semantic_hash((session_id, thread_id, index, event))
        body = event.get('body', '')
        span = m.MessageSpan(session_id=session_id, thread_id=thread_id, message_id=message_id,
                             start=0, end=len(body), quote=body)
        sheets = tuple(m.ObservedSheet(
            offer_id=s.get('term_sheet_id'), bindings=bindings(s['terms']),
            complete_bindings=bindings(closing_terms(case, s['terms'], standard_terms(events[:index + 1]))),
            source_message_ref=span,
            standing=speaker == 'supplier' and s.get('term_sheet_id') == standing_id,
            parse_issues=(),
        ) for s in event.get('term_sheets', []))
        docs = []
        for att in event.get('attachments', []):
            raw = attachment_bytes.get(att['attachment_id'])
            if raw is None or not isinstance(att.get('text'), str):
                raise ContractViolation('missing_source: attachment bytes/text unavailable')
            text = att['text']
            docs.append(m.DocumentRecord(
                attachment_id=att['attachment_id'], name=att['name'], media_type=att.get('type', 'unknown'),
                bytes_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), text=text,
                text_ref='sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                structured_refs=(), parse_status='ok', issues=(),
            ))
        claims = tuple(m.ClaimCheckResult(argument_index=r['index'], result=r['result'], source_message_ref=span)
                       for r in event.get('claim_results', []))
        messages.append(m.ConversationMessage(
            session_id=session_id, thread_id=thread_id, message_id=message_id, supplier_id=supplier_id,
            speaker=speaker, body=body, observed_sheets=sheets, attachments=tuple(docs), claim_results=claims,
            received_at=now, in_reply_to=event.get('in_reply_to'),
            content_hash=hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest(),
        ))
    status = latest.get('status', 'open')
    return m.ConversationView(session_id=session_id, thread_id=thread_id, messages=tuple(messages),
                              status=status, version_hash=semantic_hash((status, messages)))

"""Read-only contracts: no negotiation sessions or paid inference."""

import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime

import pytest

from experiments.v2.run_lab_local import DATASET
from negotiator.v2.adapters.arena_observations import conversation_from_arena
from negotiator.v2.core.errors import ContractViolation
from negotiator.v2.intelligence.citations import citation_catalog, resolve_citations, wire_schema


def observation():
    case = json.loads(DATASET.read_text())['case']
    supplier = case['suppliers'][0]
    events = [
        {'thread_id': 'thread:test', 'message_id': 'msg:0', 'from': 'supplier', 'body': 'Price EUR 33.',
         'status': 'open', 'term_sheets': [{'term_sheet_id': 'offer:0', 'terms': {'unit_price': 33}}],
         'attachments': [{'attachment_id': 'att:1', 'name': 'quote.pdf', 'type': 'pdf', 'text': 'Quote text'}]},
        {'from': 'buyer', 'body': 'Our counteroffer.', 'term_sheets': [{'terms': {'unit_price': 28}}]},
        {'thread_id': 'thread:test', 'message_id': 'msg:1', 'from': 'supplier', 'body': 'Final price EUR 30.',
         'status': 'final_offer', 'term_sheets': [{'term_sheet_id': 'offer:1', 'terms': {'unit_price': 30}}]},
    ]
    return conversation_from_arena(case, events, session_id='session:test', supplier_id=supplier,
                                   now=datetime.now(UTC), attachment_bytes={'att:1': b'original PDF bytes'})


def test_current_and_historic_sheets_documents_buyer_ack_and_final_offer():
    view = observation()
    assert view.status == 'final_offer'
    assert [m.speaker for m in view.messages] == ['supplier', 'buyer', 'supplier']
    assert view.messages[0].attachments[0].text == 'Quote text'
    assert view.messages[0].attachments[0].text_ref != 'sha256:' + view.messages[0].attachments[0].bytes_hash
    assert not view.messages[0].observed_sheets[0].standing
    assert view.messages[-1].observed_sheets[0].standing
    assert len(view.messages[-1].observed_sheets[0].complete_bindings) > 1


def test_citation_resolution_unicode_and_scope_no_model_offsets():
    view = observation()
    catalog = citation_catalog(view)
    assert len(catalog) == 2  # Buyer history cannot support a supplier claim.
    key = next(iter(catalog))
    result = json.loads(resolve_citations(json.dumps({'observations': [{'citations': [key]}]}), catalog))
    assert result['observations'][0]['citations'][0]['quote'] == view.messages[0].body
    with pytest.raises(ContractViolation, match='unknown citation ID'):
        resolve_citations('{"observations":[{"citations":["citation:forged"]}]}', catalog)
    schema = wire_schema()
    assert schema['$defs']['GroundedObservation']['properties']['citations']['items']['type'] == 'string'

import argparse

from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms

from negotiator.lab.publish import load_snapshots
from negotiator.v2.orchestration.offline import OfflineDecisionTrace


def export(root, preflight):
    original = json.loads((root / 'report.json').read_text())
    if len(original['runs']) != 1:
        raise ValueError('exactly one original negotiation required')
    row = original['runs'][0]
    run = next(r for _, r in load_snapshots(root / 'runs') if r.run_id == row['run_id'])
    attempt = run.attempts[0]
    directory = root / 'traces' / run.run_id / attempt.session_id
    terminal = json.loads((directory / 'terminal-observation.json').read_text())
    case = json.loads((root / 'case.json').read_text())
    events = attempt.threads[case['suppliers'][0]]['messages']
    supplier_evaluations = []
    for index, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get('from') == 'buyer':
            continue
        for sheet in event.get('term_sheets', []):
            standard = standard_terms(events[:index + 1])
            complete = closing_terms(case, sheet['terms'], standard)
            supplier_evaluations.append({
                'message_index': index, 'offer_id': sheet.get('term_sheet_id'),
                'status': event.get('status'), 'complete_terms': complete,
                'official_cost': total_cost(case, sheet['terms'], standard),
                'must_haves_ok': must_haves_ok(case, sheet['terms'], standard),
                'scope': 'post-run read-only evaluation; supplier estimate disabled',
            })
    traces = []
    for path in sorted(directory.glob('decision-*.json')):
        trace = OfflineDecisionTrace.model_validate_json(path.read_bytes())
        trace.verify()
        traces.append(trace.model_dump(mode='json'))
    decisions = row['metrics']['decisions']
    report = {
        'offline': {
            'environment': 'official arena-sim engine: arena_kit.sim.Sim, in-process, clock enabled',
            'arena_kit_version': importlib.metadata.version('arena-kit'),
            'source_revision': '1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53',
            'case_identity': case['case_id'], 'case_kind': 'public P10 supplied to official Sim; not bundled S01-S03',
            'run': row, 'official_outcome': attempt.result,
            'rounds': attempt.rounds, 'timeouts': attempt.timeouts,
            'interpretation_admission': sum(d['interpretation_admitted'] for d in decisions) / len(decisions),
            'fallbacks': sum(d['fallbacks'] for d in decisions),
            'model_calls': sum(d['calls'] for d in decisions),
            'model_latency_s': sum(d['latency_s'] for d in decisions),
            'negotiation_elapsed_s': attempt.elapsed_s,
            'inference_expenditure_usd': 0,
            'supplier_evaluations': supplier_evaluations,
            'supplier_offers': [e['complete_terms']['unit_price'] for e in supplier_evaluations],
            'buyer_counteroffers': [e['term_sheets'][0]['terms'] for e in events if e.get('from') == 'buyer'],
            'current_state_received': True, 'terminal': terminal,
            'strategy': 'existing supplied finite packages, scripted ambiguity interpreter and official-minimum selector',
            'proposal_changes': 0, 'justification': 'repeated official cost minimum in unchanged supplied universe',
            'live_model_reasoning_demonstrated': False,
            'source_scope': 'Lab saved run is authoritative. Later acknowledgement hardening tested without rerunning.',
        },
        'online': json.loads(preflight.read_text()),
        'comparison': 'No hosted outcome exists. Offline plumbing verified; online blocked before session creation.',
    }
    (root / 'integration-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    (root / 'complete-transcript.json').write_text(json.dumps({
        'case': case, 'events': events, 'normalized_terminal': terminal,
        'decisions': traces, 'supplier_evaluations': supplier_evaluations,
    }, indent=2) + '\n')
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':

        'interpretation_admission', 'fallbacks',
    )}, indent=2))

cat > docs/v2/arena-integration-results-2026-10-11.md <<'MD'
# V2 Arena integration and bounded execution — 11 October 2026

**One official offline negotiation completed; the online negotiation was blocked before session creation.**
No online substitute, second simulator session, live inference, retry, publication or promotion
was performed. The two-run request explicitly permits stopping before online execution if required
safety components or authorization are missing. This result does not achieve the primary objective
of demonstrating live model reasoning and safe completion in both environments.

## Implementation and contract verification

Reviewed the V2 architecture/interfaces, stabilization and latest hosted semantic experiment,
Lab failure analysis, root/package guidance, LAB_PLAYBOOK.md and official kit instructions.
The latest hosted experiment admitted 1/16 interpretations; fifteen failed before grounding.
The union diagnostic incorrectly emphasized SourceRef extra fields instead of MessageSpan errors.
No new inference allowance was inferred from that exhausted authorization.

- Added versioned `grounded-supplier-v3` / `assessment-citation-ids-v1` wire schema. The model
  selects stable, scope/content-derived citation IDs. Code resolves IDs to trusted whole-message
  spans, then applies the original AssessmentDraft schema, supplier grounding and independent
  consumer checks. Unknown IDs, forged spans and buyer citations fail closed. Conditional
  antecedents remain in whole-message spans. Provider schema identity includes the wire schema.
  No admitted live model output demonstrates that the prior hosted failures are solved.
- Retained bounded union diagnostics from both branches; prioritize the actual MessageSpan
  branch, including Pydantic's wrapped validator label. Schema-owned paths are retained and
  unknown keys are replaced by `*`; supplied values and exception prose are never persisted.
- Added a shared public Arena observation normalizer. It retains offer IDs, raw and officially
  completed bindings, standing status, complete ordered buyer/supplier history, claim results,
  attachment text, original-byte hashes and text hashes. Official `closing_terms` and the
  latest quote defaults determine completed terms. Completion does not grant acceptance authority.
- Preserved `final_offer` as actionable but distinct from `open`. Terminal notifications retain
  official result proof and the final normalized conversation; terminal state triggers no new decision.
- Interpretation and selection can see the complete scoped conversation, including changing
  offers and acknowledged buyer actions. V1/V2 body-only interpreter configurations retain their
  previous rejection behavior. New full observation projection is bounded and disclosure checked.
  The existing selector rechecks grounding; supplier text remains untrusted evidence.
- Added optional Lab attachment, acknowledgement and terminal observation hooks. Existing agents
  without hooks retain their behavior. After successful V2 submissions, authoritative thread reads
  supply buyer history. A 409 or uncertain submission never invokes the acknowledgement hook;
  locally appended buyer requests cannot establish execution. This prevents the official kit play
  loop's local request history from being mistaken for acknowledged history after timeout errors.
- Kept the existing Lab runner, recorded-decision coordinator, finite supplied packages, official
  arithmetic, fixed renderer and independent final action validator. No new orchestrator or
  deterministic strategy library, no V1 strategy changes, no closing-authority bypass.

The current recommendation was read from the shared Lab:
`e1d931e4fcce49fb8fd341c40052953a`; three prior findings were reviewed. The initial sandboxed
metadata reads failed to connect; permitted network reads subsequently succeeded. Lab is available.
The exploratory offline run uses the existing dirty-workspace provenance and local persistence;
it is not an immutable comparison campaign or a published candidate.

## Official offline and online compatibility

The official [starter-kit instructions](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/blob/main/starter-kit/README.md)
identify `arena-sim` as the contract simulator and describe the same API and agent thread contract
for simulator and hosted Arena. The [API contract](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/blob/main/brief/api.md)
is also present in the pinned local kit.

Installed `arena-kit` is **0.1.0**, pinned revision
`1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53`. Installed `arena_kit.sim` matches the pinned kit
source byte for byte; SHA-256 `df9a22cd277113ac22be16ecbcf9a9de3258b27aebb80b0a8a3c015979c9404f`.
`arena-sim serve` wraps this `Sim` engine. Run A uses it in process, with the clock enabled,
through the existing Lab client seam. It does not test HTTP routing, header idempotency or
network recovery. The supplied case is public **case:P10**, not bundled simulator case:S01-S03.

| Interface | Official offline | Official online |
|---|---|---|
| Case/session/thread/message shapes | Verified against pinned engine | Official shared contract; read-only case permissions verified |
| Attachments and full thread reader | Normalized in actual run | Same normalizer available; live hosted thread ingestion untested |
| Action validation and economics | Existing V2 pipeline exercised | Shared arithmetic exists; live execution not enabled |
| Closing and durable execution | Sends only certified offers/questions; supplier ends negotiation | Missing V2 authority and durable execution/reconciliation integration |
| Outcome retrieval | Actual owned terminal result retrieved by Lab | Not exercised; no hosted session opened |
| Server/software version | Kit 0.1.0 and pinned source revision | Hosted service build/version not exposed by these reads |

Thus the offline engine and public observation contract are compatible. **Online V2 production
compatibility is not confirmed.** The local-only factory remains deliberately blocked remotely.
Generic/multipart case loading and remote safety integration were not fabricated to satisfy a run.

## Run A — actual official simulator outcome

Lab run: `939a46c9-8689-4aae-8493-a14761fd0d5f`, session `sim1`, case:P10.
One grounded arm, one repetition, `max-sessions=1`; no other negotiation arm ran.
The actual V2 interpreter → proposal → finite generation → official economics → selector →
renderer → independent validation pipeline executed six times. The model transport is explicitly
scripted ambiguity/minimum selection, with no provider access or model expenditure.

| Round | Supplier state before action | Supplier price EUR | Buyer price EUR | Official buyer proposal cost EUR | Action valid |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | open | 32.88 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |
| 2 | open | 32.22 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |
| 3 | open | 31.56 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |
| 4 | open | 30.90 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |
| 5 | open | 30.24 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |
| 6 | final_offer | 29.59 | 27.60 | 1,333,891.20 | yes |

Each buyer sheet proposes 23,400/year, 36 months and 56-day delivery alongside EUR 27.60;
all exact fixed and negotiable terms are retained in the complete transcript. Supplier's final
response is walked_away. **Actual no deal, official score 0.0, `c_deal=null`, zero timeouts.**
The original result omits `end_reason`; the terminal thread establishes supplier walk-away.
Proposal cost is not realized agreement cost or a no-deal cost.

Read-only official supplier-sheet evaluations, using the actual quote defaults and disabled
supplier estimates, are EUR 1,962,792.50; 1,951,910.29; 1,941,028.08; 1,930,145.87;
1,919,263.67; and 1,908,546.34. All six supplier sheets fail P10's volume must-have.
These post-run evaluations are labeled separately from decision-time candidate evaluations.
They do not authorize accepting a standing supplier offer.

V2 received all six current prices and states, historical offers, attachments and buyer messages.
The terminal observation contains all thirteen messages and walked_away status. Six decision
trace digests and certified payloads verify. Observations and decisions are private local artifacts.

- Interpretation admission: **6/6**, fallback **0/6**. Selection admission: **6/6**, fallback **0/6**.
  These are scripted controls, not hosted reliability or supplier-understanding evidence.
- Proposal changes: **zero**. The existing fixed universe repeatedly selects the official cost
  minimum. No adaptation or strategic superiority is claimed; no model-driven proposal policy
  was added. All supplied prices are below the simulator's attainable agreement threshold.
- Model seam calls: **12 scripted calls**, **0 hosted calls**; measured summed latency
  **0.009638008 seconds**. Complete negotiation elapsed **0.687742498 seconds**.
- Inference expenditure: **USD 0**. Scripted token usage is unknown; the ledger conservatively
  charges **196,608 reserved tokens**, which are not provider tokens or expenditure.
- Official score is on the kit's 0–1 scale. No online buyer score exists for this assignment.

The successful run preceded the final authoritative-acknowledgement hook tightening and immutable
catalog representation fix. The run's saved provenance and traces remain unchanged and verify under
the compatible wire serializer. The final hooks have read-only unit verification; **the negotiation
was not rerun**. Its original history is corroborated by the final official thread retrieval.

## Run B — stopped before execution

Read-only credential/quota/case verification against **https://arena.tacto.ai** succeeded,
with transport retries disabled. No session POST, manual move, hosted inference or spectator
endpoint was used. Both D01/D02 sandbox cases and P10 practice are accessible. Authoritative
quota snapshot: **303 used / 297 left / 600 limit**. This current server allowance supersedes
historical documentation's 200-session limit; it is a snapshot, not a future guarantee.

Concrete blockers:

1. No fresh hosted-inference configuration/spending authorization; the previous 19-call
   authorization is exhausted and incompatible with the changed source/prompt/schema.
2. V2 has no issued production closing authority for accept/walk-away and complete closing checks.
3. V2 lacks the remote durable execution/feedback/reconciliation integration required to preserve
   move identity, exact certified payloads and safe recovery after uncertain results.
4. The registered V2 factory remains local-only and supports the reviewed single-part P10 input;
   it cannot safely substitute arbitrary hosted cases or multipart/RFQ sessions.

The user authorizes one online negotiation session, conditional on these checks; this is not an
inference-dollar allowance or permission to bypass authority. No online outcome, rounds, offers,
admission rate, latency, action validity, model expenditure or buyer score is reported.

## Evidence and verification

Original Lab record and the complete exported transcript:

- `/tmp/v2-arena-integration-offline-2026-10-11/runs/939a46c9-8689-4aae-8493-a14761fd0d5f/run.json`
- `/tmp/v2-arena-integration-offline-2026-10-11/complete-transcript.json`: every original event,
  terminal normalized history, all six decisions, economic batches, validations and supplier evaluations.
- `/tmp/v2-arena-integration-offline-2026-10-11/integration-report.json`: metrics and online preflight.
- `/tmp/v2-arena-integration-offline-2026-10-11/traces/939a46c9-8689-4aae-8493-a14761fd0d5f/sim1/`:
  six observation/decision pairs and terminal observation, including attachment text/provenance.
- `/tmp/v2-arena-online-preflight-2026-10-11.json`: credential presence/verification, case access,
  quota and blockers. No credentials are exported.

`experiments/v2/export_arena_integration.py` is a read-only exporter; it verifies original decision
traces and never opens a session. Simulator-creating integration tests were deliberately not run
because this assignment allows only one offline negotiation. The new tests use fabricated public
observations and nonnetworked client stubs to test state, grounding, schema and acknowledgements.
Final focused validation counts are recorded in the experiment log. No full repository acceptance,
live model quality gate or remote deployment readiness is claimed.

## Comparison and next steps

Only offline contract behavior was measured. Online metadata access succeeded, but there is no
hosted negotiation outcome to compare. A plain scripted supplier does not predict online supplier
reasoning. Even the fixed local strategy did not adapt to offers; richer observations alone do
not create strategy intelligence. No superiority claim is supported.

Next implement the missing remote safety components behind existing V2 ports and Lab runner,
including issued closing authority and complete checks, durable execution/reconciliation and
verified hosted-case ingestion. Separately prepare a bounded fresh inference allowance and
independent semantic review of the new citation format. Only then conduct the single online
negotiation with no automatic retry or extra session under a fresh approved execution plan.
Model-driven proposal work remains separate from this interface correction; do not add a second
orchestrator or replace official economics to obtain an agreement.

## V2 Arena observation/citation integration — 2026-10-11

Hypothesis: deterministic whole-message citation IDs and faithful public Arena observations
remove schema/observation interface bottlenecks without altering official economics or action
validation. This is a plumbing experiment, not a strategy superiority test.

Configuration/source: current dirty-workspace Lab provenance; existing P10 finite packages,
`grounded-supplier-v3`, `assessment-citation-ids-v1`, full bounded observation projection,
scripted local ambiguity/minimum responses, official arithmetic and independent validation.
Recommended Lab checkpoint read: `e1d931e4fcce49fb8fd341c40052953a`; three findings reviewed.
No checkpoint publication or promotion. Offline allowance: exactly one simulator negotiation.
Online allowance: one conditional session, stopped before creation because production safety
and a fresh inference budget are missing. No exhausted authorization reused.

Run A: `939a46c9-8689-4aae-8493-a14761fd0d5f`, official arena_kit.sim.Sim/arena-sim engine
0.1.0, pinned kit `1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53`, in process with clock enabled,
case:P10. Six rounds, six valid actions, zero timeouts, genuine terminal no deal, official
score 0.0, no realized deal cost. Supplier prices 32.88/32.22/31.56/30.90/30.24/29.59;
buyer repeats 27.60 with full terms. V2 receives all prices, final_offer, quote text/provenance
and buyer history; terminal history is preserved. Interpretation 6/6 admitted, selector 6/6,
zero fallbacks; these are scripted controls, not hosted reliability. Twelve scripted calls,
zero hosted calls, model seam latency 0.009638008 s, negotiation elapsed 0.687742498 s,
USD 0 inference. Proposal official cost EUR 1,333,891.20 each round; zero proposal changes.
Every supplier standing sheet fails the volume must-have. No acceptance bypass was attempted.

Run B: online https://arena.tacto.ai credentials and case permissions verified with read-only,
zero-retry transport; snapshot practice quota 303 used/297 left/600 limit. D01, D02 and P10
accessible. Zero session creations or model calls. Blockers: missing fresh inference
configuration/spending authority, V2 production closing authority/checks, durable remote
execution/reconciliation integration and a remote-capable factory/case loader.
No mock hosted outcome. Sandbox network reads first failed; permitted external metadata reads
succeeded, including shared Lab recommendation/findings. Lab availability is not a blocker.

Verification: six original trace digests/certified payloads verify. Focused gate 820 passed,
178 expected xfailed; after final wire/diagnostic/provenance checks, changed DTO/new contracts
691 passed, 178 expected xfailed, and model/selection/provider controls 118 passed. Scoped Ruff
and git diff --check pass. Simulator-creating integration tests were not run, preserving the
one-session allowance. Final authoritative acknowledgement hook was tightened after the
negotiation and tested with nonnetworked stubs; no rerun was performed. Original run provenance
is retained. Attachment text tampering and unknown citations reject without execution.

Decision: offline observation and citation plumbing demonstrated; no live reasoning,
adaptation, online negotiation or superiority demonstrated. Preserve the local-only remote
block. Complete existing safety ports and obtain a fresh bounded inference allowance before
online execution. Detailed interfaces, transcript and evidence:
[results](../docs/v2/arena-integration-results-2026-10-11.md),
`/tmp/v2-arena-integration-offline-2026-10-11/{integration-report,complete-transcript}.json`.
